sections.h2: How can I sell a house in Tinley Park?
sections.html:
Tinley Park sellers can use an agent, sell on their own, or take an as-is cash offer, and the paperwork differs mainly by which county holds the parcel. The village sits in both Cook and Will counties, so the first step is checking the county on your tax bill.

Tinley Park is a southern suburb of Chicago covering about 16.2 square miles, with Cook County townships Bremen, Orland and Rich and Will County's Frankfort Township under one village government. The Census Bureau counted 56,703 residents in 2010 and 55,971 in 2020, and estimates 55,140 for July 1, 2025.

sections.h2: Does Cook County or Will County handle my Tinley Park house?
sections.html:
The county where your parcel number is assigned handles the tax bill, assessment appeals and deed recording, and the village boundary does not change that. Part of the village lies in Will County, and that side includes the Brookside Marketplace shopping center.

Because the two counties run separate offices, a Tinley Park seller should find the county on the most recent tax bill and ask that county's treasurer for the paid-to-date figure. Cook County's due dates change from year to year, as the table further down shows.

sections.h2: What do Tinley Park homes and households look like?
sections.html:
Census Bureau figures for 2020 to 2024 describe a village of long-term owners and a long drive to work for many residents.

  • Homes occupied by their owners: 86.9%
  • Typical value of an owner's home (median): $299,900
  • Median gross rent: $1,495
  • Households: 22,320, averaging 2.45 people
  • Median household income: $105,189
  • Residents who had not moved in the past year: 92.0%
  • Average commute: 33.7 minutes
  • Residents age 65 or older: 21.5%

sections.h2: Where does Tinley Park sit, and what is its housing stock?
sections.html:
The village borders Oak Forest to the northeast, Orland Park to the northwest, Orland Hills and Mokena to the west, Country Club Hills to the east, Matteson to the southeast and Frankfort to the southwest. It runs under a council-manager form of government.

The 2020 census counted 22,751 housing units, of which 3.3% were vacant. The homeowner vacancy rate was 1.1% and the rental vacancy rate was 7.5%. The median age was 43.0, and 19.5% of residents were 65 or older. The Census Bureau's 2020 to 2024 estimates add that 37.0% of adults hold a bachelor's degree and 9.3% of residents were born outside the United States.

Retail is a large part of the local economy. The Census Bureau's 2022 figures show retail sales of about $1.81 billion, or $33,380 per resident, plus health care and social assistance receipts of about $361 million.

Settlers arrived in the 1820s, and by the 1840s a large German community had formed, so the village took the name Bremen when it was founded in 1853. It was renamed Tinley Park in 1890 for the first station agent at the Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific depot and incorporated on June 27, 1892.

The railroad drew a washing machine factory in 1905 and a cola bottling plant that ran into the 1950s. The big change came later: between 1970 and 1994, more than 11,000 housing units were built, mostly west and south of the original center. The village has since worked on its historic downtown, which follows the 1892 boundaries, and the outdoor amphitheater that opened in 1990 now holds about 28,000 people per event.

sections.h2: Which schools and commuter routes serve Tinley Park?
sections.html:
Four elementary districts cover the village: Kirby District 140, Community Consolidated District 146, Summit Hill District 161 and Elementary District 159. Victor J. Andrew High School in District 230 and Tinley Park High School in Bremen District 228 are both in the village, while small areas feed Lincoln-Way East and Rich Central. Residents are mostly in the Moraine Valley Community College district, with the rest in South Suburban College or Joliet Junior College territory.

Metra's Rock Island District has two stations here, Tinley Park on Oak Park Avenue and the 80th Avenue station. Pace runs routes 356, 364 and 386. The main roads are I-80 east to west, Harlem Avenue (IL 43) north to south, 159th Street (US 6) in the north and La Grange Road (US 45) at the western edge.

sections.h2: What do Cook County installment due dates look like?
sections.html:
Cook County's due dates move. The Treasurer's Office due dates page lists these recent ones.

Cook County property tax installment due dates, tax years 2023 to 2025
Tax yearFirst installmentSecond installment
2023March 1, 2024August 1, 2024
2024March 4, 2025December 15, 2025
2025April 1, 2026October 1, 2026

The Treasurer also lists exemptions that Cook owners can apply for, including the homeowner, senior citizen, senior assessment freeze, disability, home improvement, military, disabled veteran and first responder's surviving spouse programs. On the Will County side, the Treasurer explains that delinquent taxes become a lien that tax buyers purchase at an annual sale, and homeowners typically have one to three years to redeem before a buyer can start court action.

sections.h2: What does the Tinley Park Building Division require?
sections.html:
Building, electrical and plumbing permits are required for most home improvements and additions, and the Building Division asks owners to call 708-444-5100 before starting if they are unsure. A homeowner may do work on their own property, with the exception that changing electric service needs a licensed electrical contractor. Any contractor the owner hires must be licensed and bonded with the village before work starts.

  • Apply with one copy of your plat of survey, normally provided at your closing, and any drawings or sketches.
  • Post the building permit placard at the site until the work is complete.
  • Work started without a permit can result in a fine.
  • Inspections by the village's plan review consultant run from 8 a.m. to noon on weekdays.

The village notes that its comprehensive building code was revised and adopted on July 20, 2026, and lists the 2024 International codes among the current ones.

sections.h2: What if I am behind on the mortgage on a Tinley Park house?
sections.html:
The Building Division page points to a Foreclosure Property Registration Program run through ProChamps, with a separate page for defaulted mortgage property registration. If a lender has started foreclosure on your home, ask the Building Division whether registration applies to you.

Illinois law also treats some of these transfers differently when a house is sold. Under 765 ILCS 77/15, a deed from a mortgagor to a mortgagee in lieu of foreclosure, or a consent judgment, is exempt from the seller disclosure report. An ordinary sale still requires the report to reach the buyer before the contract is signed under 765 ILCS 77/20.

Investors who buy Tinley Park commercial space use a separate Change of Use/Owner application with a $50 fee, which does not apply to homes.

faqs.q: Is Tinley Park in Cook County or Will County?
faqs.a: Both. The village spans Cook and Will counties, and the county on your tax bill decides who bills the tax and records the deed.

faqs.q: When are Cook County property taxes due for a Tinley Park home?
faqs.a: The dates change yearly. The first installment was due March 4 in 2025 and April 1 in 2026, and the second was due December 15, 2025 and October 1, 2026.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to finish a basement in Tinley Park?
faqs.a: Most home improvements and additions need building, electrical or plumbing permits. Call the Building Division at 708-444-5100 to confirm for your project, and bring your plat of survey.

faqs.q: What happens if I sell a Tinley Park house through a deed in lieu of foreclosure?
faqs.a: Illinois exempts a deed in lieu of foreclosure from the seller disclosure report, and the deed still records with the county.

faqs.q: How fast can a Tinley Park house sell for cash?
faqs.a: The contract date, title search and payoff letters set the pace. A buyer paying cash does not wait on mortgage underwriting, and the deed is then recorded with the county.
